Project Title: Ocean Sequestration of CO2 Field Experiment
Evidence Text: DOE would provide funds for development of experimental plans, public outreach, permitting, data analysis, modeling predictions, and other support functions; the DOE funding would equate to about 20% of the total estimated cost of the experiment. The primary purpose of the Field Experiment would be to develop the data needed to verify scientific principles and to test, validate, and refine computer models used for predicting the behavior of carbon dioxide released into the ocean at moderate depth.
